pull_request.title: feat: add rate limiting to API gateway
pull_request.body:
Closes #15

## Changes
- Added token-bucket rate limiter middleware
- 100 req/min per API key by default, configurable via env var
- Returns 429 with Retry-After header when limit exceeded

## Testing
- Unit tests added for rate limiter logic
- Manual test: 150 requests in 60s — 100 succeed, 50 return 429
